title: Neon Plasma Armory Expansion Proof
product_type: Internal Sci-Fi Asset Expansion Capability Proof
theme: Original neon industrial science fiction matching Neon Plasma Armory: dark gunmetal bodies, compact cyan energy elements, restrained violet accents, and readable functional silhouettes

generation.perspective: consistent 2D game-sprite presentation; readable side or slight three-quarter view for compact items and furniture; centered camera-facing shape for VFX
generation.outline: Use a one-pixel dark outline at final sprite resolution and the same crisp pixel-cluster language as the approved weapon sprites
generation.lighting: Cool cyan energy light, upper-left neutral rim light, restrained violet highlights, no cast shadow

assets.name: Plasma Power Cell
assets.description: a compact replaceable plasma power cell with a dark reinforced casing, cyan charge window, small violet status light, and clearly readable connection contacts
prompt_notes: Show one upright cartridge-sized object in slight three-quarter side view
Keep the cyan chamber enclosed by the casing and avoid weapon-like handles or barrels

assets.name: Energy Pickup
assets.description: a compact collectible energy pickup with a protected cyan core held inside a small symmetrical gunmetal frame
prompt_notes: Design a clear collectible silhouette that differs from the rectangular power cell
No floating particles, floor, aura, letters, numbers, or extra pickup objects

assets.name: Plasma Grenade
assets.description: a palm-sized plasma grenade with a squat rounded armored body, protected cyan energy chamber, top safety control, and restrained violet indicator
prompt_notes: One compact throwable device in readable three-quarter side view
Avoid familiar real-world grenade silhouettes and avoid franchise-specific shapes

assets.name: Plasma Proximity Mine
assets.description: a low-profile deployable proximity mine with a broad stable base, four short armored sensor fins, central cyan detection core, and violet arming light
prompt_notes: Show the complete mine from a slightly elevated side view so its footprint reads clearly
No floor contact shadow, warning text, skull symbols, or extra devices

assets.name: Portable Shield Emitter
assets.description: a compact portable shield emitter with a weighted gunmetal base, two folded side vanes, central cyan projector core, and restrained violet controls
prompt_notes: Show the inactive device only, without a surrounding shield bubble
Keep it clearly distinct from a mine through its upright projector silhouette

assets.name: Shield Impact Keyframe
assets.description: one isolated science-fiction shield-hit effect keyframe shaped as a curved cyan energy arc with a bright compact contact point and a few restrained violet pixel fragments
prompt_notes: Effect only with no shield device, character, weapon, projectile, environment, or circular full-screen bubble
Use an asymmetric curved impact silhouette suitable as the strongest frame of a short animation

assets.name: Plasma Burst Keyframe
assets.description: one isolated plasma burst effect keyframe with a compact brilliant cyan center, short irregular energy spikes, and restrained violet outer fragments
prompt_notes: Effect only with no projectile, weapon, target, smoke cloud, environment, or multiple explosions
Keep the silhouette compact and radial but visibly irregular for a readable impact animation keyframe

assets.name: Armory Supply Crate
assets.description: a closed compact science-fiction supply crate with reinforced gunmetal corners, inset cyan power latch, restrained violet status light, and readable industrial panel seams
prompt_notes: Show one complete crate in slight three-quarter side view
No logos, letters, numbers, contents, weapon attachments, floor, or shadow

assets.name: Armory Chair
assets.description: a practical single-seat science-fiction armory chair with a dark angular metal frame, padded blue-gray seat and back, small cyan adjustment light, and restrained violet accent
prompt_notes: Show one empty chair in slight three-quarter side view with all legs or base fully visible
No person, desk, floor, cast shadow, wheels, text, or extra furniture

assets.name: Armory Workbench
assets.description: a sturdy science-fiction armory workbench with a dark reinforced frame, clear tabletop, integrated cyan power strip, closed storage drawers, and restrained violet controls
prompt_notes: Show one complete empty workbench in slight three-quarter side view with generous canvas padding
No weapons, tools, chair, loose objects, text, floor, cast shadow, wall, or scenery

notes: Internal capability proof only. No generated item joins the public product until it passes human review and a versioned package-extension gate.
Use the approved Neon Plasma Armory palette and functional vocabulary without copying an existing franchise, object design, or asset pack.

evidence.label: Operator-approved technical capability experiment for an existing ORION product
